variants.headline: Still in view: party divides in two
variants.sub: The colony has seen a party divide into two organisations.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. A political party has split in two in {colony}.

We judge {target} harshly in this matter. Political organisation carries obligations beyond the comfort of its leaders, and division is an appropriate occasion to question the quality of that stewardship.

variants.headline: Still in view: unity gives way to a party split

variants.body:
